preconditions.description: The number of sentences T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The length of the Bytelandian alphabet permutation M is exactly 26 characters.
The Bytelandian alphabet permutation M is a permutation of the English alphabet 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100 for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S in the input has a length between 1 and 100 characters inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_.,!? ' for c in S) for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and the punctuation symbols '.', ',', '!', and '?'.

postconditions.description: The number of translated sentences in the output is equal to the number of input sentences T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i]) == len(sentences[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence in the output has the same length as the corresponding input sentence.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ .,!? ' for c in output[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence in the output contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, spaces, and the punctuation symbols '.', ',', '!', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ''.join(M[ord(c) - ord('a')] if 'a' <= c <= 'z' else c for c in sentences[i].replace('_', ' ')) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence in the output is the correct translation of the corresponding input sentence, with underscores replaced by spaces and lowercase letters translated according to the Bytelandian alphabet permutation M.
